writeup: Woot has the Sharpie Creative Markers fine tip 24-count variety pack (model 2209904) for $14.99. It's the water-based acrylic set that adds the newer earth tones to the core colors and paints on paper, wood, rock, glass, metal and canvas. Walmart lists the same 24-pack at $38.97, Michaels at $59.99 and Staples at $69.99, so this is about 61% under the cheapest store we found.
